page0.text:
...
She moves faster than expected.
The girl in knight's armor leaps out of the shed without hesitation.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page0:1

page1.text:
What!?
I forget about the pain I feel, and I get up to follow her.
She can't possibly go up against that guy!
No matter how heavily armored she is, she's smaller than I am.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page1:1

page2.text:
"Stop—"
The echoing clang drowns out my words.
"Wha—"
I can't believe what I'm seeing.
My head really does go blank this time.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page2:1

page3.text:
"Who the hell is she?"
The clash of swords echoes around me.
The moon slips behind the clouds, and the yard grows dark once again.
And within the darkness, sparks fly as steel strikes steel.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page3:1

page4.text:
Without saying a word, the spear-wielding man meets the girl who leaped from the shed.
She parries his spear, and knocks away his other successive attacks, driving him back with each attack.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page4:1

page5.text:
...
I-I can't believe it.
This girl, Saber, is somehow overpowering the man.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page5:1

page6.text:
The battle has begun.
What happened between that man and I earlier doesn't even count as battle.
A battle? That's a fight between two people, each able to kill the other.
No matter the difference in ability, it can still be called a battle as long as both are able to kill the other.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page6:1

page7.text:
In that sense, these two are fighting a battle.
The man attacks her, swinging his spear so quickly I can't even see his strikes.
Somehow...
She parries his every attack perfectly, with...something as she closes in on him.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page7:1

page8.text:
"Damn!"
The man backs up slightly, clicking his tongue hatefully.
He holds his spear vertically to ward off her attacks on his side.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page8:1

page9.text:
"Gngh!"
For a moment, his spear glows.
His attack almost looks like it caused an explosion.
The man's spear sparks as if electrified every time whatever weapon the girl is wielding strikes it.
The man and I both could tell what it is.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page9:1

page10.text:
It's furious magical energy, so dense it can actually be seen.
Her attacks are charged with incredible amounts of magical energy.
The unbelievable amount of magical energy crackles along her opponent's weapon every time they make contact.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page10:1

page11.text:
The sheer force of her attacks must be staggering.
If the man's spear strikes are precise, like a sniper rifle, her blows must be like the overpowering blast of a shotgun.
Each of the girl's attacks bathes the yard in flickering light.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page11:1

page12.text:
And yet...
That's not what's overpowering the man.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page12:1

page13.text:
"Coward! Why are you concealing your weapon!?"
The man curses at the girl as he evades her unrelenting attacks.
...
She doesn't respond other than to step up her attacks with her invisible weapon.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page13:1

page14.text:
"You...!"
The man retreats, having hardly so much as a chance to counterattack.
Her weapon is invisible.
Without being able to determine the weapon's range, it'd be reckless to go in for an attack.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page14:1

page15.text:
That's the trouble with an invisible weapon...
...but she's definitely got something in her hand.
I can't make out anything of its shape or length.
Maybe it's transparent to begin with. No matter how many times sparks fly from it, I never get a look at the weapon's profile.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page15:1

page16.text:
"Tch!"
Parrying her strikes must be taking a lot out of the man; his movements aren't as sharp as they had been.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page16:1

page17.text:
...
It's the first sound the girl makes.
She attacks all the more furiously.
It's a merciless, unyielding dance of blades.
The flying sparks remind me of a blacksmith striking iron.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page17:1

page18.text:
And the spear-wielding man continues defending himself as he disapprovingly clicks his tongue.
Honestly, I can't help but to admire the man, even though he tried to kill me.
He's able to defend himself from an invisible weapon, relying only on reading the girl's swings and footwork.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page18:1

page19.text:
"Hmph!"
But that's all he can do.
When an opponent is so completely on defense, the only thing you need to do is beat them down. The girl steps in closer.
She smashes down, striking with all her might...!
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page19:1

page20.text:
"Don't get carried away, fool!"
Seeing his chance, the man disappears.
Or rather, he retreats back as if to disappear.
The girl's swing cuts through the air and smashes into the ground, kicking up dust.
Her massive swing, which seemed to be a fatal blow against the cornered spearman, proved easy to dodge.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page20:1

page21.text:
"That fool, what the hell is she thinking!?"
Even I could tell what happened, even at this distance.
Her careful, precise attacks earlier may have worn the man down, but the tremendous swing meant to deal the finishing blow wouldn't ever touch him.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page21:1

page22.text:
The relentless attacks must have put incredible strain on the man's body as he tried to defend himself.
Yet he suppressed that pain for a single moment to jump away.
He knew that her last attack would determine the victor!
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page22:1

page23.text:
"Hah!"
The man jumps back several meters, then comes in to strike once again the moment his feet touch the ground.
He jumps in a triangular pattern, and leaps towards the girl as if revisiting his steps.
The girl's sword is still embedded in the ground.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page23:1

page24.text:
"!!!"
It's a fatal opening.
The red spear returns in less than a second.
The girl twists her body around like a top...
...while her sword is still embedded in the ground.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page24:1

page25.text:
"Gngh!"
The whole thing happens in a matter of seconds.
The man sees his mistake and tries to correct...
...as the girl uses this brief moment to use her whole body to attack!
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page25:1

page26.text:
"Gngh!"
...
Both the man and the girl seem unsatisfied though.
Both struck, intending to kill.
Both survived, so everything leading to this moment was in vain.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page26:1

page27.text:
The two open a bit of distance between themselves.
They both just quietly stare at each other; the strain the battle inflicted on them seems to be too much.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page27:1

page28.text:
"What's wrong, Lancer?
Would you tarnish the name of all warriors of the spear by just standing there? If you aren't going to attack, then I will."
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page28:1

page29.text:
"Hah. Running to your death already? Fine by me, but let me ask you one thing first.
Is your Noble Phantasm a sword?"
He phrases his question so bluntly.
He glares as if trying to look through her.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page29:1

page30.text:
"Who can say?
It might be a battle-ax, a spear, or sword. Perhaps even a bow."
"Gh... Keep talking, Saber."
Somehow, this conversation seems to be amusing him.
The man called Lancer briefly lowers his spear.
It looks as if he's saying he doesn't want to fight anymore.
"Hm?"
The girl seems puzzled by Lancer's move.
But I know what his stance means.
I remember the fight at school a few hours ago.
It's the killer move that was supposed to have ended the battle.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page30:1

page31.text:
"I'm going to ask you one more thing: Since this is the first time we've met, wanna call it even for now?"
...
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page31:1

page32.text:
"Not a bad deal, right? Your Master over there looks pretty useless, and my Master's a big coward who won't even show their face.
Don't you think it's in both our best interests to hold off fighting until we're in better conditions?"
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page32:1

page33.text: "I refuse. You will die here, Lancer."
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page33:1

page34.text:
"Is that so? Man, I just came here to check things out. I wasn't going to stick around once a Servant appeared."
The air wavers.
Their surroundings appear to distort.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page34:1

page35.text:
Lancer lowers his stance.
A chill creeps into the air.
The same thing happened earlier. Magical energy rumbles as it forms a vortex at the tip of the spear.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page35:1

page36.text:
"A Noble Phantasm!"
The girl readies her weapon and glares at her enemy.
I don't need to speak up.
She knows very well how dangerous the enemy is; she is the one confronting him.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page36:1

page37.text:
"See ya. Your heart is mine!"
The beast kicks the ground.
Lancer appears in front of the girl so quickly he may as well have teleported.
He takes his spear and aims at her feet.
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page37:1

page38.text:
...
Even to me, that seems like a poor choice.
I can't see any way an attack would be effective with the spear pointed at the ground in front of her feet.
Apparently thinking the same, the girl leaps over the spear toward Lancer, intent on striking him down.
But at that moment.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page38:1

page39.text:
"Gáe..."
His words alone radiate immense magical energy...
"Bolg!"
The spear released from below angles toward the girl's heart.
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page39:1

page40.text:
"!?!?!?"
Her body hangs in the air.
The blow sends her flying in a wide arc. She smashes heavily into the ground.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page40:1

page41.text:
"Haaa...ungh!"
She's bleeding.
She had been unscathed until now. But her heart is pierced, and she is bleeding profusely.
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page41:1

page42.text:
"A curse...? Or...a reversal of fate!?"
I'm just as bewildered.
But watching from afar may have given me a better perspective on how bizarre the attack was.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page42:1

page43.text:
The spear had been aimed at her feet. I'm sure of that.
But then it just...changed direction, moving and stretching impossibly to pierce the girl's heart.
And yet...the spear itself neither stretched nor changed direction.
It seemed, bizarrely, as if the spear had been thrust into her chest from the beginning, almost...naturally.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page43:1

page44.text:
It wasn't as simple as the spear changing its trajectory and piercing the heart.
The spear didn't change course. It altered truth itself to make that happen.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page44:1

page45.text:
The moment he spoke those words and released his spear, the intent of piercing her heart had been realized.
Essentially, his attack reversed cause and effect.
The result of the attack piercing the victim's heart is predetermined, so the spear's trajectory is merely an afterthought to establish the facts.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page45:1

page46.text:
It's a demonic splinter that breaks through all defenses.
The moment it determines the target, the spear pierces the heart every time it's used, without exception.
How can anyone defend against such a completely insane attack?
No matter what effort the target makes to evade, the spear will always pierce their heart.
Which makes it fatal.
An accursed spear that always pierces the opponent when used.
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page46:1

page47.text:
However...
...the girl evades by a hairbreadth.
The spear did penetrate her, but it didn't hit anything vital.
Her actions in evading the spear seemed even more impossible than the spear itself.
The moment the spear was thrust, the girl turned and reversed direction with an incredible effort of will and strength, as if she knew what was going to happen.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page47:1

page48.text:
She was either incredibly lucky, or had just enough protection to dampen the spear's curse.
Whatever it is, the girl manages to avoid the fatal blow, and so survives Lancer's ultimate attack.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page48:1

page49.text:
"Haa... Haah..."
The girl tries to get her labored breathing under control.
Although she had been losing a lot of it, blood stops seeping from her wound, and even the wound itself is closing up.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page49:1

page50.text:
...
So this is what a truly extraordinary person can do.
I knew she wasn't normal, but she is more than outstanding.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page50:1

page51.text: In terms of her skills in the fight against Lancer...in terms of the incredible amount of magical energy used for every attack...her body recovering on its own... She is obviously superior to Lancer.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page51:1

page52.text:
But that's only up until now.
She may be healing even now, but her wounds are deep.
If Lancer attacks now, she won't be able to defend herself.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page52:1

page53.text:
And yet...
Even though he's at an overwhelming advantage, Lancer doesn't move.
He audibly grinds his teeth.
And he glares at the girl.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page53:1

page54.text:
"How the hell did you evade my fatal Gáe Bolg, Saber?"
His voice seems to rumble up from the ground itself.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page54:1

page55.text:
"Did you say Gáe Bolg? So, you're Ireland's Child of Light!?"
Lancer's expression darkens.
His hostility dissipates, and he clicks his tongue in annoyance.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page55:1

page56.text:
"Damn. I screwed that up. If I pull this move out, it's really got to be fatal. Sometimes being famous is a bit of a pain, you know."
The oppressive mood lightens.
Lancer no longer seems to have any intent of attacking the wounded girl; he turns his back as he walks to the corner of the yard.
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page56:1

page57.text:
"Now that my identity's been revealed, the usual Servant rules say we should fight to the death...but, like I said, my Master is a coward. They're even telling me to retreat since my spear failed."
"Are you running away, Lancer?"
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page57:1

page58.text:
"Yeah. Follow if you like, Saber.
Just know that if you do, I'll kill you."
He lightly bounces off the ground.
It's a wonder how agile he can still be, but Lancer jumps effortlessly over the fence and disappears before anyone can stop him.
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page58:1

page59.text:
"Wait, Lancer!"
The injured young girl turns and starts running in pursuit.
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page59:1

page60.text:
"Y-you've got to be kidding me!"
I cross the yard as fast as I can.
If I don't stop her, she'll go after him and maybe get herself killed.
It turns out I don't need to chase after her.
She tries to jump over the wall, but the moment she crouches to jump, she doubles over and grabs her chest.
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page60:1

page61.text:
"Kngh...!"
I hurry over to check on her.
Well, I'd intended to just approach and call out to her, but that went right out the window the moment I got near her.
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page61:1

page62.text:
...
She is...completely unbelievable.
The shining silver armor she wears looks extremely heavy.
The clothing she's wearing, dated as it is, is a bright, vivid blue. I've never seen anything like it.
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page62:1

page63.text:
No...her clothes are not what really enthralls me.
She is absolutely beautiful.
Her golden hair, illuminated by the moonlight, is extremely fine as spun gold.
Her face is graceful with a trace of innocence, and her smooth white skin all but glows in the moonlight.
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page63:1

page64.text:
...
I'm speechless. Her beauty completely takes my breath away.
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page64:1

page65.text:
"How'd this happen?"
Seeing a girl wounded in a fight made me absolutely furious.
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page65:1

page66.text:
As I stand there gawking, the girl remains silent, her hand clamped over her chest.
I manage to quit staring pretty quickly.
She lifts her head and lets her hand fall from her chest, her pain seeming to have eased.
She looks directly at me.
I don't know quite how to respond to that gaze... But then I notice something.
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page66:1

page67.text:
"Your wound's...gone?"
The spear missed her heart, but it did pierce her chest...yet there's no outward sign of a wound.
I've heard there's a kind of healing magecraft, but she didn't seem to use anything like that.
That must mean she can heal herself, no matter how wounded she is.
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page67:1

page68.text:
"...!"
My mind switches gears.
I shouldn't be gawking at her. This girl is unbelievable, and I absolutely should not let my guard down around her until I know who she is and what's going on.
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page68:1

page69.text:
"...Who the hell are you?"
I take half a step back as I ask the question.
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page69:1

page70.text:
"What do you mean? I am Saber. A Servant.
You are the one who called me here, so you needn't ask."
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page70:1

page71.text:
"Saber? Servant?"
"Yes. So please address me as Saber."
She says it so casually.
There's a touch of contempt in her tone, but it remains mostly gentle, and...hearing her voice makes my head go blank.
"Wh-what?"
Why the hell am I getting agitated?
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page71:1

page72.text:
"I-I see. That's a weird name."
I cover my burning face with a hand and respond stupidly. But I honestly don't know what else to say.
Besides, how else would she respond when I just ask her what the hell she is? And it'd be rude for me to not respond.
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page72:1

page73.text:
"I'm Shirou. My name is Shirou Emiya, and I live here."
There's something wrong with me.
I'm saying the dumbest things...
But, well, she did give me her name. It's only polite that I give mine.
I know I'm confused, but it's still important to remain rational no matter who I'm dealing with.
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page73:1

page74.text:
...
The girl...Saber, just keeps watching me in my confusion. She moves not an inch.
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page74:1

page75.text:
"Forget all that. That's not what I was asking. It's that..."
"I know very well that you are not a typical Master."
"Eh?"
"Yet you are still my Master. As long as we have formed a contract, I will not betray you. You need not be on your guard around me."
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page75:1

page76.text:
"Uh..."
Crap.
I hear her, but I couldn't be more lost.
The only thing standing out to me is that she keeps referring to me as "Master."
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page76:1

page77.text:
"You've got it wrong. My name's not Master."
"Very well, then I will call you Shirou. Yes, I like that better."
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page77:1

page78.text:
"...!"
The moment she said my name, I thought my face might actually burst into flames.
Isn't it a bit more normal to call someone by their last name when you first meet?
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page78:1

page79.text:
"Wait. Why would you choose to address me that—"
"Ouch!"
A strange sensation tingles through my left hand.
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page79:1

page80.text:
"It's hot...!"
The back of my hand is burning.
A strange pattern appears on the back of my left hand, like a tattoo.
page80.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page80:1

page81.text:
"Wha...!?"
"Those are called Command Spells, Shirou.
They are three spells which command a Servant's obedience. They are a Master's very life, so please use them carefully."
page81.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page81:1

page82.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page82:1

page83.text:
"Shirou, please heal me."
Her tone is cold now.
It seems she's not focused on me, but something elsewhere.
page83.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page83:1

page84.text:
"Wait. Are you asking me? Sorry, but I don't know how to use complicated magecraft like that, and you're already healed anyway."
Saber frowns.
I feel like I've said something that disappoints her.
page84.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page84:1

page85.text:
"Then I shall face them as-is. My regeneration has only repaired the superficial damage, but one more battle shouldn't affect me."
"One more battle? What do you mean?"
page85.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page85:1

page86.text:
"There are two enemies outside. From what I can sense, I am sure I can defeat them in a few seconds."
Saber leaps over the wall effortlessly.
Just like Lancer, she makes it look easy.
And now I'm just alone in the yard.
page86.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page86:1

page87.text:
"Enemies outside?"
I realize what she means as soon as I say it.
"Wait! Are you going to keep fighting!?"
I move without thinking.
I run as fast as I can toward the gate.
page87.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page87:1

page88.text:
"Haah...haah!"
I reach the gate, unlock it with trembling fingers, and jump out.
page88.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page88:1

page89.text:
"Saber, are you here!?"
I strain to see in the darkness.
Clouds have completely obscured the moon, leaving it pitch dark. Now of all times!
But...
page89.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page89:1

page90.text:
I hear something nearby.
"There!"
I run to an empty pathway.
page90.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page90:1

page91.text:
It happens all in an instant.
I see a familiar man in red and Saber fighting.
Saber rushes him and breaks through his guard in a single sweep...
page91.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-00:page91:1
